description: This file is a Perl module defining functions and variables for parsing and managing package, target, and metadata information in a build system, specifically related to OpenWRT or similar embedded Linux distributions. It includes functions for parsing package metadata and target configurations, handling user and group IDs, and extracting multiline data from files.

methods.name: get_multiline
methods.description: Reads multiple lines from a file handle until a line starting with '@@' is encountered, concatenating them into a single string with optional prefixing.

methods.name: confstr
methods.description: Transforms a configuration string by replacing slashes and dots with underscores.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata_usergroup
methods.description: Parses and validates user or group specifications in package metadata, ensuring IDs and names are consistent and within valid ranges.

methods.name: parse_target_metadata
methods.description: Reads target configuration details from a file, extracting metadata about build targets, profiles, and subtargets.

methods.name: clear_packages
methods.description: Resets internal data structures related to packages, versions, categories, and user/group information.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata
methods.description: Parses package metadata from a file, populating internal data structures with package details such as name, version, dependencies, and description.

methods.name: parse_package_manifest_metadata
methods.description: Parses package manifest metadata from a file, capturing details like package name, version, source, dependencies, and other metadata.
